transcript: Ishan, but comes and insists ki "Main job chhod doon? Yaar ye AI me to sab upskilling ho rahi hai. Ab sabko to AI skills seekhna hai sab log. Is it a thing that you recommend?" And the worst part that I see with Gen Z today is the death of real intelligence. Since AI is something that people use every single day, to wo apna khud ka dimaag use karna hi chhod dete hain. And I see this often. They are just like getting the answer from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and just pasting it into the answer. And abhi recently, maine ek activity kari thi in my office, and I got two people in one room. No internet, no AI, no laptops, just a pen and paper, and I gave them a report, and I asked them ki "Aapko ispe a reel banani hai, LinkedIn post, and aapke paas do ghante hain." And they had the worst time of their month. So the question is not, "Will AI become as smart as humans?" The real question is ki "Kya hum... will we stop upskilling, and will we get down to the level that AI is at right now?"
caption:
Do you agree?

Aayush and I had a chat at NDTV Yuva on the problem with GenZ using AI at work.
